questions.question: How distinct should agents feel?
questions.answer: CORRECTION: Agents are CAPABILITIES, not personas. No voice. Expertise-based, not personality-based.
questions.insight: Over-engineered the personality concept. Agents are tools with specialization, triggered by user or orchestrator.

questions.question: Technical boundary between branches?
questions.answer: CORRECTION: ONE CODEBASE. All experimental. No product/dev split yet. Still at alpha.
questions.insight: Over-complicated. One branch, one codebase. Eventually decide what becomes public.

questions.question: Where does Notient end and Obsidian begin?
questions.answer: BOTH: Obsidian = File System + Editor. Notient = Intelligence Layer (sidecar).
questions.insight: Clear separation. Obsidian stores and edits. Notient thinks. No overlap.

questions.question: What metric defines Beta success?
questions.answer: CEO's personal trust: willing to use on real vault (not test vault). Vault self-organizes, tasks complete reliably, AI maximized.
questions.insight: Not team metrics. Personal trust in software quality. Engineering excellence first.

synthesis: Major recalibration needed. Agents are capabilities (not personas). One codebase (no branch split). Success = CEO's personal trust to use on real vault. Obsidian = storage/editor, Notient = intelligence sidecar. Stop over-engineering.
keyDecisions: Success = CEO trusts it for real vault
Notient = intelligence layer sidecar to Obsidian
recalibration: Interviewer was over-engineering abstractions. Ground in reality: one person, one codebase, personal trust metric.
